candidates.description: DrawCardWithEvent draws a card for a player and fires the draw event.
candidates.doc:
DrawCardWithEvent draws a card for a player and fires the draw event.

Rule 616/614.16-ish ([VOCAB] #1291): before drawing, checks for an active
draw-replacement effect (e.g. "if you would draw a card, you may instead
search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle" —
installed via cardfns.GrantDrawReplacement/ReplaceDrawWithLibrarySearch).
If one applies, its substituted action runs INSTEAD of the draw: the card
is never drawn from the library the normal way, and no draw event/trigger
fires below, since a draw never actually happened. This is distinct from a
triggered "whenever you draw a card" reaction, which exists alongside the
real draw rather than replacing it.
candidates.name: DrawCardWithEvent
candidates.title: DrawCardWithEvent

candidates.description: handleMonarchEndStepDraw implements "at the beginning of the monarch's end
candidates.doc:
handleMonarchEndStepDraw implements "at the beginning of the monarch's end
step, that player draws a card" (Rule 718.3). firePhaseEvents fires
EventEndStep once per turn with ev.Player set to the ACTIVE player (whose
end step is occurring, see StepEnd in firePhaseEvents) — so this only
draws when the active player IS the current monarch, never for the other
player's end step.
candidates.name: handleMonarchEndStepDraw
candidates.title: handleMonarchEndStepDraw

candidates.description: ResolveSequenceChoice answers a pending optional atom. accept=true executes
candidates.doc:
ResolveSequenceChoice answers a pending optional atom. accept=true executes
the atom (still honoring its own executor's pending flows), then the walk
continues; accept=false skips it. Either way the outcome feeds subsequent
if_you_do / if_you_dont links.
